page.layout: One printed page of text, with a narrow block of text on the right edge of the scan (partly cut off, the facing page), and a faint margin on the right side of the main column. Running head at top; main text in one column; a catchword-like word "Quod" at the lower right of the column.

main_text.p: hujus magnitudinem & dona non satis quidem perpendunt, & tepidâ fide ad Sacramentum accedunt, servant tamen institutionem & verba Christi, fieri participes corporis & sanguinis Christi. Et de hac, inquit, posteriori interpretamur 1. Cor. 11. Hanc rem expositum elegantissime Rivetus in defensione doctrinæ Christianæ contra Lubertum. Epist. Abric. Quum, inquit, expendere libet, quales D. Paulus agnoscat Corinthios, quos hîc corripit: fatendum est, eos ipsi habitos inter membra Christi, & qui fidem haberent. Nam vocat eos fratres: & judicium, in quod inciderunt ob admissam discordiam & indignitatem, a judicio mundi separat, & sibi commune facit. Dum judicamur, inquit, à Domino corripimur, ne cum mundo condemnemur. Hinc sit Corinthii, etsi adeò indignè manducassent, ut id sibi judicii accersitum, quòd multi apud eos ægrotarent, ac mortui rerentur, tamen quia vere in Dominum credebant, ac cum fide, quanquam tardis attentâ, cœnæ adessent, Dominum manducabant & ad salutem, idque judicium in quod inciderunt ob indignitatem suam temporarium fuit, & indulgentiæ paternæ, ut quo ideò corripiebantur, ne cum reliquo mundo condemnarentur.

page.notes: Right-hand facing page is cut off and only partly legible (fragments such as "rum", "criti", "Chr", "unic"), so it is not transcribed. Many words in the scan are obscured by stains and show-through; the transcription of damaged passages is approximate and some words are uncertain ([?] not marked due to pervasive damage). Marginal text on the right edge is largely illegible. The word "Quod" at lower right is a catchword-like mark, treated as part of the running text.
